concerns.text: Normalization step computes `normalized_loss = per_token_loss / ngram_probability`. Dividing a cross‑entropy loss (in nats or bits) by a raw probability mixes incompatible units and lacks a theoretical justification. Standard practice to control for token‑frequency bias is to work in log‑probability space (e.g., subtract the n‑gram log‑probability from the model log‑probability) or to regress loss on n‑gram probability and use residuals. The current division may introduce spurious scaling and could artificially inflate or deflate correlations with complexity metrics, jeopardizing the validity of the subsequent correlation and threshold analyses.
